topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't quite get my head around it, the news just sitting there, heavy and unyielding. My best friend is moving across the country. It’s been nothing but planning and packing, and the reality hasn’t quite sunk in. We've always been a constant in each other’s lives, through the good and the tough times. Now, I find myself imagining all the moments we won’t share, the silent gaps that distance will inevitably create. I keep thinking, maybe there’s something I can do, some way to make this less... stark. I’ll focus on that, the positives, the plans we can make, the visits and the digital chats. It’s just, it’s a big change, and I’m not sure how to feel about it just yet.
